a: mRNA carries genetic instructions from DNA to ribosomes.
Translation builds proteins from mRNA codons.
A codon is a triplet of bases coding for an amino acid or stop.
Mutations are changes in DNA sequence.
Pathogens are organisms that can cause disease.
Antibodies bind specific antigens to help clear threats.
Vaccines train immune memory without causing the full disease.
A niche is an organism's role and conditions in an ecosystem.
Biodiversity is the variety of life in a habitat or on Earth.
